blurb: Southern Fly Expeditions offers guided fly fishing and light tackle conventional spin fishing charters in the Louisiana marsh near New Orleans. Guests fish for species such as bull redfish, jack crevalle, black drum, and others in a natural marsh environment. The experience includes sight fishing on flats skiffs with a guide who assists with casting and fish handling.
